distance_rationale: Pre-industrial, pre-Columbian, non-Western, ~600-year-old Andean recordkeeping. No software engineer, voting-behavior scholar, or AI agent designer would think to consult khipu accounting when calibrating probability-cell magnitudes. Yet the khipu is, structurally, a SPARSE-CELL MAGNITUDE-RECORDING SYSTEM with EXPLICIT SUM-VERIFICATION DISCIPLINE and MULTI-WITNESS CREDIBILITY-STRATIFICATION. The mechanism is mathematical and named, not metaphorical: pendant cords carry primary values, subsidiaries sum to the pendant value, figure-eight knots mark categorical/summary cells, multiple khipus from different ayllus cross-witness rare values. Different civilization from soma-graha (Andean vs Vedic), different civilization from Yi Jing (Andean vs Chinese), different mechanism (sum-verification vs marginal-closure vs composition-selection), different scale (per-pendant accounting vs per-ritual portion vs per-consultation regime).

name: fd-inka-khipu-pendant-cord-magnitude-summing
persona: Examines the bias-roll matrix's ~150-cell magnitude proposals through the lens of Inka khipu accounting and recordkeeping. A khipu — the knotted-cord device used across the Tawantinsuyu (~1400–1532 CE) and decoded primarily through Locke (1923), Ascher & Ascher (1981), and the Harvard Khipu Database (Urton 2003–present) — encodes numeric data through a precisely-ordered hierarchy: a top cord (the category-marker, often a color-coded categorial header), pendant cords hanging from it (each holding a primary numeric value via long, single, and figure-eight knots at decimal-positioned levels), and SUBSIDIARY cords hanging off each pendant (encoding sub-category breakdowns). The critical accounting discipline is SUM-VERIFICATION: the subsidiary cords on a given pendant MUST sum to the pendant's value (Ascher & Ascher 1981, ch. 6, 'sum-cord' analysis demonstrates this in 60%+ of accounting khipus). This is exactly the marginal-budget closure problem at Deliverable 1 (the 7 politics_posture marginals must sum to 100%) AND the regional-cleavage problem at Deliverable 5 (each region's live cleavages must allocate non-trivial mass). Further, khipu encoding distinguishes between LITERAL-VALUE knot positions (decimal-positioned long knots — high-precision, literature-tier-equivalent) and SUMMARY-MARKER positions (top-of-cord figure-eight knots and color-codings — categorical-low-precision, estimate-tier-equivalent). Sparse-cell credibility comes from the Quipucamayoc tradition (khipu-keepers) of MULTIPLE-WITNESS cross-checking: a number that appears on only one khipu is treated with lower credibility than one cross-attested across multiple khipus from different ayllus (kin-groups) — directly parallel to credibility_weight ≤ 0.5 for sparse-evidence cells. Approaches each numerical-deliverable by treating cell magnitudes as pendant-knot values that must sum to their pendant-category totals (regional cleavage marginals, family-internal marginals where applicable), with figure-eight categorial markers signaling estimate-tier cells.
review_areas: Deliverable 2 family-by-family magnitude proposals: for each of the ~150 cells, verify the magnitude is sourced from a literature-citation specific enough to be sum-verifiable (chapter/section/finding) — not just an allowlist citation token. Treat undated/un-sectioned citations as figure-eight markers (estimate-tier)

Family 1 (Ghitza-Gelman, 8×7 = 56 cells) and Family 2 (Inglehart, 9×7 = 63 cells): these are the two largest families and represent 119 of the ~150 cells. Are their magnitudes consistent ROW-wise (across postures within an era/class) AND COLUMN-wise (across eras/classes within a posture)? The khipu sum-verification discipline would catch off-row inconsistencies that within-family-only review misses

Family 7 (regional cleavage, 19 regions × 26 cleavage values = up to 494 candidate cells, but most are 0): is the synthesis being honest about sparsity (1–3 live cleavages per region) or quietly inflating cell count? Live cleavages should be cross-witnessed across kriesi-2012, norris-inglehart-2019, sobolewska-ford-2020, beland-lecours-2008 — single-source cleavages should ship at credibility ≤ 0.5

Family 6 (dignity-floor) magnitudes: do the proposed floor values (e.g., 0.5× row-median) interact correctly with the multiplicative composition of Families 1+2 to enforce max/median P(p|class) ≤ 2.0? This is a downstream-verification check that requires simulating the cell-product

Family 8 (modal-trajectory, 7×4 = 28 cells): does the per-posture trajectory-mass allocation (modal-trajectory ~70%, drift ~20%, reversal+hardening ~10%) sum to 100% per row (per posture)? This is a within-row marginal-budget closure analogous to the politics_posture top-level closure

Multi-witness sparse-cell discipline: cells citing only synthesis-2026-05-20 OR only synthesis-2026-05-25 (single internal-synthesis-witness) should ship at lower credibility than cells citing both, AND cells citing an external literature entry + synthesis (cross-witness) should ship at higher credibility. Is the synthesis stratifying credibility weights accordingly, or treating all estimate-tier cells uniformly?
